headline: Powell: Economic outlook depends heavily on *virus spread*
quote: the economic outlook is evolving on a daily basis
title: Powell, Mar 2020: Economic outlook depends on virus spread
caption: Fed Chair Jerome Powell explained why official economic projections were omitted during the emergency March 2020 press conference. He noted that the outlook changed daily depending on the virus's spread.
comment: How well did the Fed handle economic uncertainty at the start of the pandemic?
